name: ONNX Trader clusters
summary: This EA uses two ONNX neural network models — a main model and a meta-model — to generate binary classification signals for EURUSD trading. The main model predicts trade direction (buy/sell) while the meta-model acts as a confidence filter, only allowing trades when its output exceeds a threshold. It executes trades with fixed SL/TP and position sizing based on risk percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA使用两个ONNX神经网络模型——主模型和元模型——生成EURUSD的二元分类交易信号。主模型预测交易方向（买入/卖出），元模型作为置信度过滤器，仅在其输出超过阈值时允许交易。它以固定止损/止盈和基于风险比例的仓位管理执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双模型机器学习架构：主模型输出分类概率作为方向信号，元模型输出概率作为信号置信度过滤。入场条件为：当元模型概率大于meta_threshold时，若主模型概率小于(1-main_threshold)则买入，若大于main_threshold则卖出；买入信号低于0.5意味着模型预测上涨概率更高，卖出信号高于0.5则预测下跌概率更高。出场条件为：当元模型确认时，若持有多头且主模型信号大于main_threshold则平多仓，若持有空头且主模型信号小于(1-main_threshold)则平空仓。仓位管理通过MaximumRisk参数按账户可用保证金比例计算手数，也支持固定手数ManualLot，并有最小/最大手数限制和手数步长规范化。资金管理使用CheckMoneyForTrade函数在下单前检查保证金是否充足，防止因资金不足导致订单失败。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built on a dual-model machine learning architecture: the main model outputs classification probabilities as directional signals, while the meta-model outputs probabilities as a confidence filter for signal quality. Entry conditions: when the meta-model probability exceeds meta_threshold, a buy is triggered if the main model probability is below (1-main_threshold), and a sell is triggered if it exceeds main_threshold; a buy signal below 0.5 indicates the model predicts higher upward probability, while a sell signal above 0.5 predicts higher downward probability. Exit conditions: when the meta-model confirms, existing long positions are closed if the main model signal exceeds main_threshold, and short positions are closed if the signal falls below (1-main_threshold). Position sizing calculates lot size based on the MaximumRisk parameter as a fraction of account free margin, with support for fixed ManualLot, and enforces min/max volume limits plus volume step normalization. Money management uses the CheckMoneyForTrade function to verify sufficient margin before placing orders, preventing order failures due to insufficient funds.

parameters.name: main_threshold
parameters.description: 主模型信号阈值，超过此值视为卖出信号
parameters.description_en: Main model signal threshold; exceeded = sell signal

parameters.name: meta_threshold
parameters.description: 元模型置信度阈值，超过此值才允许交易
parameters.description_en: Meta-model confidence threshold; must exceed to allow trading

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description: 渐进式手数系数，用于按保证金比例计算手数
parameters.description_en: Progressive lot coefficient based on margin ratio

parameters.name: ManualLot
parameters.description: 固定手数，0表示使用动态计算

parameters.name: OrderMagic
parameters.description: 订单魔术号，用于标识本EA的持仓
parameters.description_en: Order magic number identifying this EA's positions

pros: 双模型架构设计合理，元模型作为置信度过滤器能有效减少低质量信号的交易
使用ONNX模型进行推理，能够捕捉非线性市场特征，比传统技术指标更有潜力
包含完整的资金管理检查（保证金验证、手数规范化、最小/最大手数限制）
pros_en: Dual-model architecture is well-designed, with the meta-model acting as a confidence filter that effectively reduces trades on low-quality signals
ONNX model inference can capture non-linear market features, offering more potential than traditional technical indicators
Includes comprehensive money management checks (margin verification, lot normalization, min/max volume limits)
cons: 无限重试循环（do-while res==-1）可能导致无限阻塞，缺少最大重试次数限制
countOrders函数使用PositionSelect而非PositionGetTicket遍历，在多持仓时会重复选择同一持仓导致计数错误
止损止盈固定为2000点且无追踪止损机制，无法根据市场波动动态调整
元模型和主模型使用相同特征时缺乏正交性验证，可能导致过滤效果有限
cons_en: Infinite retry loops (do-while res==-1) can cause indefinite blocking without a maximum retry count limit
countOrders uses PositionSelect instead of PositionGetTicket for iteration, which can repeatedly select the same position and cause incorrect counts with multiple positions
Fixed SL/TP of 2000 points with no trailing stop mechanism prevents dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
No orthogonality verification between meta-model and main model features, potentially limiting the filtering effectiveness
improvements: 为do-while重试循环添加最大重试次数限制和超时机制，避免无限阻塞
修复countOrders函数，使用PositionGetTicket(k)正确遍历持仓而非PositionSelect
添加spread过滤和滑点控制，防止在高点差环境下开仓
考虑添加追踪止损或动态止损机制，根据ATR等波动指标调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add maximum retry count and timeout mechanism to do-while retry loops to prevent indefinite blocking
Fix countOrders function to use PositionGetTicket(k) for proper position iteration instead of PositionSelect
Add spread filter and slippage control to prevent opening positions in high-spread environments
Consider adding trailing stop or dynamic stop-loss mechanism adjusted by volatility indicators like ATR

risk_points: 无限重试循环可能在高延迟或服务器断连时导致EA卡死
countOrders函数计数错误可能导致超过max_orders限制开仓
Sleep(50)在重试循环中使用会阻塞EA线程，影响其他逻辑执行
无点差过滤，在流动性低的时段可能以较大滑点成交
risk_points_en: Infinite retry loops may freeze the EA during high latency or server disconnection
countOrders function counting errors may allow opening positions beyond max_orders limit
Sleep(50) in retry loops blocks the EA thread, affecting execution of other logic
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
